market_summary: NEW_YORK_SESSION shows strong continuation in gold breakdown driven by negative GEX amplification, while US100 tests dealer Call Wall resistance near session highs. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain inside Value Areas in tight consolidation below VWAPs, and BTCUSD consolidates above VAH with neutral-to-divergent CVD.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4023.16) and below POC (4044.14). CVD is BEARISH (-3.00, agreeing with sell bias). SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4033.21) and EMA50 (4018.84). ATR bands expanding down with price sitting near lower ATR band. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING (price below Gamma Flip 3995.63), accelerating downside flushes toward next put wall/support. Weak low-volume bounce rejected near Gamma Flip.
signals.level_event: rejection at Gamma Flip 3995.63 and testing lower ATR band

Price is above VAH (28343.60) and above POC (28267.73). CVD is BULLISH (+13.11). SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28217.30) and EMA50 (28329.02).
